[[File:Convertor_coil.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A converter coil]]
'''Converter coils''' were a component used in [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. The wires in the converter coil of the left engine of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] constantly burned out, indicating a problem with the [[Power regulator/Legends|power regulator]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
